questions.question: Who attended Tokyo Jujutsu High with Geto?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto/Synopsis

answer.item: He was scouted by Tokyo Jujutsu High and attended it with Satoru Gojo and Shoko Ieiri.

questions.question: What did Geto do to the villagers of the village he was sent to?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto/Synopsis

answer.item: Days later, Geto is sent on a mission to a village, but decides to massacre the villagers when they asked him to kill two young sorcerers, Mimiko and Nanako Hasaba, even after he had exorcised the curse.

questions.question: What did Geto do when he took over the Star Religious Group?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto/Synopsis

answer.item: Geto meets with most of the former Star Religious group members and explains to them that he will be taking over. He even kills one of them, Shigeru Sonoda, to make his point across.

questions.question: What did Geto plan to do on December 24th?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto/Synopsis

answer.item: Geto says that he will release 2000 spirits all over Japan on December 24th.

questions.question: How did Kenjaku reanimate Geto's corpse?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto/Synopsis

answer.item: After this, Gojo chooses not to have Geto's body taken in by Jujutsu High and cremated. This allows Kenjaku to place his brain into Geto's corpse, reanimating it and granting him access to all of his abilities and memories.

questions.question: What did Gojo discuss with Geto in the afterlife?
questions.subject: Suguru Geto/Synopsis

answer.item: After dying, Gojo has a talk with Geto and his dead comrades in the afterlife about how Sukuna was holding back during their fight.
